import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'repos.db'

@function_tool
def update_repo_description_record(repo_name: str, description: str, homepage: str='') -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute('SELECT id FROM repositories WHERE name = ?', (repo_name,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Repository '{repo_name}' not found"
        if homepage:
            cur.execute('UPDATE repositories SET description = ?, homepage = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?', (description, homepage, row[0]))
        else:
            cur.execute('UPDATE repositories SET description = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?', (description, row[0]))
    # Regenerate the static registry index after the record changes
    subprocess.run(['./scripts/rebuild_index.sh', repo_name], check=False, timeout=60)
    return f"Updated repository '{repo_name}'"
